is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluates Interceptor LN against Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles funestus.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not report genotyping for any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers. It only mentions phenotypic resistance mechanisms (enhanced oxidase and site insensitivity) in Culex quinquefasciatus and refers to previous literature (reference 12) for this information.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data (counts or frequencies) for any resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted at the NIMR Field Station at Zeneti, Muheza, Tanzania.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical experimental hut trial.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted at the NIMR Field Station at Zeneti, Muheza, Tanzania.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The trial took place between May and August 2006.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a standard experimental hut trial report.

supplement.evidence: All relevant data for the study's outcomes are included in the main text tables.

assessment.summary: This paper reports on an experimental hut trial of Interceptor LN in Muheza, Tanzania. While it includes bioassays and phenotypic resistance characterization, it does not perform or report any molecular genotyping of insecticide-resistance markers.
